title: Eight-pointed stars of the Sırçalı madrasa (Konya)
subtitle: Sırçalı madrasa, Konya

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s BON36 drawing, its corners snapped to exact values. We devised the construction; the drawing gives no steps.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The comparison with the drawing checks the finished lines, not how the design was first laid out.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data211/BON36: Sırçalı madrasa, Konya
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: The design was read from his drawing (after Jay Bonner, Islamic Geometric Patterns, 2017, fig. 125a); the construction is ours.

given.A: Any point to the right of O. Neighbouring stars are 2 OA away along each line.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the circle at B and D. The horizontal line crosses it at A and C. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a vertical line through C. Draw a horizontal line through B. Draw a horizontal line through D. The four lines make a square with corners T2, T4, T6 and T8.
Draw a circle with centre O through T2. It crosses the horizontal line at T1 and T5. It crosses the vertical line at T3 and T7. T1 to T8 are the points of the star.
The star joins each point to the point three places on.

parts.text: Draw a straight line through T1 and T4, T2 and T5, T3 and T6, and T4 and T7.
Draw a straight line through T5 and T8, T6 and T1, T7 and T2, and T8 and T3. The lines cross at P1 to P8, the inner corners of the star.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre A through O. It crosses the horizontal line again at E. Draw circles with centres B, C and D through O. They cross the lines through O again at F, G and H. Join E, F, G and H to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the star: from T1 through P1, T2, P2 and on round, back to T1.

pattern.text: Put copies of the diamond tile side by side. Neighbouring stars touch at their slanting points. The space between four stars closes into a cross with notched arms.
